subject: Coffee & Tea
title: What Is Specialty Coffee?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is Specialty Coffee?.

hook.text: Specialty coffee scores 80+ points on a 100-point scale judged by certified Q-graders. It's the top 5–10% of all coffee.

buildup.text: Scoring evaluates aroma, flavor, aftertaste, acidity, body, balance, and defects. It's rigorous and standardized.

discovery.text: Specialty beans fetch $3–25+ per pound versus $1–2 for commercial grade. Quality commands real premiums.

twist.text: The specialty segment grows 20% annually while total coffee consumption grows only 2%. It's the industry's bright spot.

climax.text: For farmers, producing specialty-grade coffee is the clearest path out of commodity poverty—if they can access training.

punchline.text: Quality scores above 80 unlock a different economy entirely.

quiz.question: What score must coffee achieve to be classified as 'specialty'?
